test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Nandan had some marbles. When he distributed the marbles equally among 32 children, he found that 4 marbles were left. Had he distributed the marbles equally among 41 children and 48 children, he still would have had 13 and 20 marbles, respectively, left with him. But when he distributed them equally among 53 children, no marble was left. The number of marbles that Nandan initially had may lie between __________.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__
Check the common difference between **divisors** and **remainders**.

32 − 4 = 28, 41 − 13 = 28, 48 − 20 = 28.

Number = LCM(32, 41, 48) × k − 28, and it must be divisible by 53.

LCM(32, 41, 48) = 7872. For k = 1, Number = 7872 − 28 = 7844.

7844 ÷ 53 = 148 (Remainder 0). So, 7844 is the number.

**∴ The correct answer is 7834 and 7854.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8aae85ef718862e22a50564a627c80d4869327bb1ec4d8991b806deb4aa5cf6f.png] 
**Given:** Divisors (d₁, d₂, d₃) = 32, 41, 48 | Remainders (r₁, r₂, r₃) = 4, 13, 20.

⇒ Common difference (d − r) = 32 − 4 = 28; 41 − 13 = 28; 48 − 20 = 28.

⇒ LCM(32, 41, 48) = 2⁵ × 41 × 3 = 32 × 123 = 7872.

⇒ General form: N = 7872k − 28.

⇒ Condition: N must be exactly divisible by 53.

⇒ Test k = 1: N = 7872(1) − 28 = 7844.

⇒ Verification: 7844 = 53 × 148 + 0. (Condition satisfied).

⇒ 7844 lies between 7834 and 7854.

**∴ The correct answer is 7834 and 7854.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM with Common Difference

When (Divisor − Remainder) is constant (say x), the number is LCM(Divisors) × k − x.

LCM with Same Remainder

If every divisor leaves the same remainder r, the number is LCM(Divisors) × k + r.

Divisibility Rule of 53

To check if a number is divisible by 53, add 16 times the last digit to the rest of the number.</p
